ITEM 1 | Rectangular/triangular folded flatbread-like pastry piece, pale golden-tan with slightly browned edges and a flaky, layered surface, about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide at its base, partly opened to show a filling of dark reddish-brown minced mixture with specks of green and bits of pale grain, moist-looking, holds its shape, sits at the left of the plate near the corn piece | 95

ITEM 2 | Half of a yellow corn cob cut crosswise, pale yellow kernels with a slightly glossy, moist surface and a firm, compact texture, about 4.5 cm diameter and 3 cm thick, lying cut-side up on the plate below the pastry | 70

ITEM 3 | Dark green sautéed or cooked leafy greens, with some wilted, glossy, curled leaves and a few thin stems, mixed with whole green beans, forming a loose mound about 12 cm long and 9 cm wide on the upper right of the plate, moist with a slight sheen, soft and limp in texture | 110

ITEM 4 | Whole green beans, bright to medium green, slender and about 6–8 cm long, lying together with the leafy greens in the upper right portion, firm and crisp-looking with a smooth surface | 35

ITEM 5 | Chickpeas, tan-beige, round, whole and intact with slightly wrinkled skins, scattered in a cluster about 9 cm by 6 cm on the lower right of the plate, mixed with pieces of soft diced vegetables | 80

ITEM 6 | Diced cooked vegetables, including small pieces of pale yellow-white onion and bits of red and orange pepper, soft and glistening with a little oil or juices, mixed among the chickpeas in the lower right, about 5 cm across | 30

ITEM 7 | Scattered loose chickpeas, tan and individual, dispersed around the base of the pastry and corn on the left-center of the plate, each about 1 cm across, dry-looking | 15
